evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Improve issue discoverability and reduce the repository's unlabeled-issue percentage below 5% through appropriate classification.
intent.acceptance: Partial facet: count native first-label coverage gains minus last-label withdrawals on open issues. Replay historical eligibility, not current labels backdated. Classification correctness, component completeness, explanatory comments, workflow attribution and the whole-repository percentage target remain unmeasured.

evidence.opportunity: Open unlabeled issues in the frozen surviving-identity cohort.
filters: Replay all retained label, assignment, closure and reopening events from creation; reconcile terminal state.
Exclude no unknown issue as if clean: complete totals become null; retain explicitly observed native subtotals.
Transfers, deleted identities and unreconciled histories remain unknown.
Any-label coverage is a partial discoverability facet, not proof of correct classification or full triage.
Repository condition changes are not attributed to either workflow; comments, run success and label counts do not establish classification correctness.
The surviving cohort omits deleted/transferred-away issues; do not apply the whole-repository 5% goal to its observed subset.
evidence.collection: Replay one shared, digest-checked, resumable issue condition archive offline. Retain period counts and native-event ledger digests instead of duplicating the event archive in every plot.

model.recommendation: Review native label-coverage progress separately from workflow attribution, classification correctness and costs.

presentation.label: Issue label-coverage delivery
presentation.betterLabel: More covered issues, fewer coverage withdrawals
